description: Reserve a unique USDC amount for this API key. Send that exact amount to PAYMENT_ADDRESS, then claim_payment. Receive-only; this server never holds a private key.

from_address.description: Optional paying wallet (0x…). When set, only that sender can match this intent.

pack_id.description: Credit pack id, e.g. pack_10, pack_25, pack_50, plan_desk.

usd.description: Custom USDC amount if not using a listed pack.

name: create_topup_intent
